title: Hypotheses (T1)–(T5) and (E1)–(E3) for tame types
body_html:
(T1)–(T5) and (E1)–(E3) for tame types

Proposition. For the tame Yu/AFMO data of [[node:applications.tame_K_F_construction]]:

  • (T1)–(T5) hold: (T1)–(T3) from Yu's construction; (T4) from the global intertwiner identity Global intertwiner I(φ_y, φ_x) = K_x G^(0) K_y / support corollary.
  • (E1)–(E3) hold: (E1) from Yu directly; (E2) from [AFMO2 Prop 3.6.13]; (E3) from Hom(κ_x, κ_y)_{K∩K} one-dim and G^{(0)}-trivial (proves (E3)).

This is the tame-side counterpart of [[node:applications.classical_T_axioms]].

The global existence of the $\kappa$-family on the closed chamber of $\mathcal B(G_\beta)$ (needed for (T1) facet-constancy and (T3) $G$-equivariance to be literal rather than up-to-iso at each point) is provided by Skodlerack–Ye Thm 5.21 in the quaternionic case; see Global β-extension existence (compatible κ-family on B(G_β)). The same correction-by-quadratic-character technique applies to the AFMO tame $\kappa_x$ by replacing the finite reductive signature characters of [Skodlerack–Ye §5.2] with the Yu-side reductive quotients of $\mathrm P^\circ(\Lambda_x)/\mathrm P_1(\Lambda_x)$ inside Yu's twisted Levi $G^{(i)}$'s.
